name: Kowasare Shimai
source: After the sudden accidental death of their mother, the lives of the Akitsugawa sisters take a drastic turn. On the night of their mother's funeral, their stepfather makes an unreasonable demand, stating that from then on, it is their duty as daughters to fulfill his sexual desires. He leaves it up to the elder sister, Sumire, to decide which one of them will become his object of pleasure. Sumire, torn by conflicting emotions, makes a fateful choice. Thus begins a period of humiliation and violation as she is subjected to her stepfather's desires. The story further unfolds as she becomes entangled with various other men, leading to her gradual deterioration and destruction.
translation: 母亲意外猝死后，秋津川姐妹的生活发生了剧变。在母亲葬礼当晚，继父提出了一个无理的要求——从今以后，满足他的性欲是她们作为女儿的义务。他让姐姐堇来决定她们中的哪一个将成为他的玩物。被矛盾情感撕裂的堇做出了一个命运的选择。于是，一段在继父欲望下遭受凌辱和侵犯的日子就此开始。故事进一步展开，她与各种各样的男人纠缠在一起，逐渐走向堕落和毁灭。
